import primitive_api as api

ctx = api.get_task_context()
print("Context:", ctx)

obs = api.inspect_current_view(label="init", remember=True)
print("Initial pose:", obs["observation"]["agent"])
print("Initial visible:", [o["objectId"] for o in obs["visible_objects"]])

scan = api.scan_scene(
    queries=["ButterKnife", "Knife", "Cup", "Mug", "Shelf", "CounterTop"],
    rotations=4,
    include_tilts=True,
    remember=True,
)
print("Scan query hits:", {k: [x["objectId"] for x in v] for k, v in scan["query_hits"].items()})
print("Progress:", api.check_progress_public())

steps.title: The episode reaches its success condition.
steps.code:
import primitive_api as api

mem = api.recall_visible_objects(limit=50)
for m in mem:
    print(m.get("objectId"), "pos:", m.get("position"), "dist:", m.get("distance"), "seen_at:", m.get("agent_pose"))

res_pickup_knife = api.pickup_located_object(
    query="ButterKnife",
    aliases=["Knife"],
    support_queries=["CounterTop"],
    search_budget=24,
    open_containers=False,
)
print("Pickup knife:", res_pickup_knife["ok"], res_pickup_knife["inventory"], res_pickup_knife["progress"])

if res_pickup_knife["ok"]:
    res_place_in_cup = api.place_held_object(
        receptacle_query="Cup",
        support_queries=["Shelf"],
        search_budget=24,
    )
    print("Place in cup:", res_place_in_cup["ok"], res_place_in_cup["progress"])
    
    if res_place_in_cup["ok"]:
        res_pickup_cup = api.pickup_located_object(
            query="Cup",
            support_queries=["Shelf"],
            search_budget=16,
            open_containers=False,
        )
        print("Pickup cup:", res_pickup_cup["ok"], res_pickup_cup["inventory"], res_pickup_cup["progress"])
        
        if res_pickup_cup["ok"]:
            res_place_on_counter = api.place_held_object(
                receptacle_query="CounterTop",
                search_budget=24,
            )
            print("Place on counter:", res_place_on_counter["ok"], res_place_on_counter["progress"])

print("Final check_success:", api.check_success())
print("Final progress:", api.check_progress_public())
